title: Products never ordered
statement_markdown: Return product names that have never appeared in order_items. Sort by product name.

examples.explanation: This output comes from the visible sample data.

hints: Start with every product and preserve products without matches.
Filter the joined rows where the order-item id is NULL.
explanation: The anti-join pattern uses LEFT JOIN plus IS NULL to find products with no matching order item. A common mistake is testing product_id IS NULL from the products table. NOT EXISTS expresses the same intent and often reads naturally.
reference_solution: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.name
